text: The fixed accepted scheduler records NS_ERROR_UNEXPECTED for the outstanding queue and falls through to completion if initializing the retry timer fails. The older warn-and-return path is not the current completion contract. Preserve final listener delivery and lifetime release when adding an asynchronous failure branch; otherwise deferred work can remain retained.
